name: Paper worlds science

provenance.description: Sanitized design constraints adapted from an owner-authored paper-worlds template.

visuals.art: Bright topic-specific cut-paper scenes with crisp edges and shadows.
visuals.layering: Keep foreground subject objects separate from the background; avoid a flattened hero scene.
motion: A new causal timeline for each explanation
visuals.topicConstraint: Use stars only when they explain a space topic.

typography.textZones: Stable cream or navy areas with wrapping and checked phone-size contrast.

editorial.structure: Open with a natural question and explain its concrete causal mechanism.
editorial.evidence: Check primary factual sources and preserve qualifiers.
editorial.cover: Create a topic-specific 1080x1920 cover with a natural search phrase and a short SEE WHY or SEE HOW invitation.
editorial.publicationCopy: Use a natural key phrase first; avoid reach promises.
editorial.closing: Write and record your own short closing invitation.

audio.speech: Preserve complete word endings and check transitions into the closing invitation.

captions.instruction: Prepare captions for the languages of your brief and check them against the final audio.

review: Inspect rendered pixels and visible independent layer motion.
Check phone-size typography, wrapping and contrast.
Listen to complete speech, word endings and audio transitions.
Verify caption timing against the final audio.
Retain editable source and hashes of final deliverables.
